cli_args.description: List of command-line arguments to pass to chaosreader. Each item must be a valid argument string as documented in chaosreader(1).

output_dir.description: Output directory for generated files; corresponds to -D dir.

tcp_ports_playback.description: TCP ports to create replay scripts for (e.g., ['25', '79']). Corresponds to -b port[,...].

udp_ports_playback.description: UDP ports to create replay scripts for (e.g., ['36', '42']). Corresponds to -B port[,...].

tcp_ports_html.description: TCP ports to create HTML views for (e.g., ['7', '79']). Corresponds to -l port[,...].

udp_ports_html.description: UDP ports to create HTML views for (e.g., ['7', '123']). Corresponds to -L port[,...].

tcp_ports_only.description: Only examine these TCP ports (e.g., ['21', '23']). Corresponds to -p port[,...].

tcp_ports_skip.description: Exclude these TCP ports (e.g., ['80', '81']). Corresponds to -P port[,...].

udp_ports_only.description: Only examine these UDP ports (e.g., ['53']). Corresponds to -p port[,...].

udp_ports_skip.description: Exclude these UDP ports (e.g., ['5353']). Corresponds to -P port[,...].

ip_addrs_only.description: Only examine these IP addresses (e.g., ['10.1.2.1']). Corresponds to -j IPaddr[,...].

ip_addrs_skip.description: Exclude these IP addresses (e.g., ['10.1.2.1']). Corresponds to -J IPaddr[,...].

min_conn_size.description: Minimum connection size to save (e.g., '1k'). Corresponds to -m bytes[k].

max_conn_size.description: Maximum connection size to save (e.g., '1024k'). Corresponds to -M bytes[k].

sort_order.description: Sort order: 'time', 'size', 'type', or 'ip'. Corresponds to -o type.

standalone_minutes.description: Standalone mode duration in minutes for single capture. Corresponds to -s mins.

standalone_count.description: Number of standalone samples (used with standalone_minutes). Corresponds to -S mins[,count].

standalone_redo.description: If true, reprocess last run’s logs (standalone redo mode). Corresponds to -z.

dump_filter.description: BPF filter string for standalone mode. Corresponds to -f 'filter'.

prefer_dns.description: Show DNS names instead of IP addresses. Corresponds to -d.

include_html_index.description: Include HTML index files. Corresponds to --noindex to disable (inverted).

include_info_files.description: Include .info session info files. Corresponds to --noinfo to disable (inverted).

include_raw_files.description: Include raw session files. Corresponds to --noraw to disable (inverted).

include_application_files.description: Include application session files. Corresponds to --noapplication to disable (inverted).

include_tcp.description: Include TCP traffic. Corresponds to --notcp to disable (inverted).

include_udp.description: Include UDP traffic. Corresponds to --noudp to disable (inverted).

include_icmp.description: Include ICMP traffic. Corresponds to --noicmp to disable (inverted).

include_everything.description: Create HTML and hex files for everything. Corresponds to -e.

include_keydata.description: Create keystroke analysis data. Corresponds to -k.
